label: Compare inclusive actual-order explanation with contained contingent bruteness
summary: See docs/notes/explanatory-adequacy-750.md#restricted-bruteness-local-success-versus-exact-order-explanation-2026-11-25. Draft PR-1968 continues PR-1872/1908/1910/1927/1933. Distinguishes local derivative, structural, generic-role and inclusive actuality explananda. Under the proposed scope principle, the latter cannot be fully answered while its included B lacks an adequate reason; does not imply universal existential coverage. Two populated finite worlds retain one brute contingent base each, all derivative reason assignments, fixed identities, invariant constraints and a correct resident-observer identity decoder. Role-only observations cannot distinguish occupants uniformly; conditioning on the actual essentially dependent D0 screens off its base-absence world. Finite assignments and rational probability samples checked with a standalone Python diagnostic, not a Lean certificate. A necessary exemption can be directly warranted without falling within the being-level contingent PSR; even a contingent rule fact is not automatically a being. Positive priority, conditional essence, necessary role occupancy and intrinsic self-intelligibility have distinct explanatory scopes. The inspected firstMoverNecessaryByEsseCause proof uses B2 only at its selected f; a mover-scoped strength restriction is proposed, not registered or checked for novelty. Retain BX1/BX2 and actual firstness/priority/existence premises. A nonnecessitating actual reason may explain the recipient without uniquely determining an act; scope, operative content and actual production remain separate. No premise established, no new formal edge or source claim. Prior accepted E/D and practical-content assessments remain intact.
blocker: Universal adequate existential coverage and the adequacy-to-token/domain bridge remain OPEN. A principled priority or constitutive feature has not yet been shown to warrant eligibility of a brute contingent actuality as an ultimate stop, nor has the opposite been demonstrated. Test the same bearer's intrinsic existential self-intelligibility versus conditional essence using existing natureModel, B6 and C2. Mover-scoped PSR/BX1/BX2 and B2 proposal needs related/novelty/semantics preflight and elaboration, binding and certificate checks before registration. Same-source operative practical content and actual evidence-channel applications remain as in PR-1933. No general epistemic deficit follows without a specific non-discriminating channel and no other warrant. Independent semantic challenge and canonical validation are outstanding.

current_assessment.scope: Inclusive existence scope, role occupancy, epistemic screening and same-mover coverage
current_assessment.assessment: Proposed unreviewed synthesis: a contained brute input leaves the inclusive actual-existence question unanswered if that question covers the very base and the scope principle is accepted. This is explanatory incompleteness, not a contradiction, independent derivative bruteness or universal epistemic failure. Fixed-role constraints, a positive exemption criterion and reliable cognitive inference are compatible with the displayed structural assignments. Essential identity information may remove occupant ambiguity, without supplying an ontic why. A necessary source with adequate actual nonnecessitating production could improve the comparison, but no such adequate source or personal-over-impersonal ranking is established. Retain the earlier moderate preference for E and suspension about D; no change to their accepted review status.
current_assessment.next_test: Compare a positive criterion for intrinsic existential intelligibility of the same contingent bearer against mere conditional essence and the rival's principled primitive-stop license. Reuse natureModel, B6 and C2. Test a mover-scoped version of the existing PSR/BX1/BX2-to-B2 argument and firstMoverNecessaryByEsseCause after checking for existing variants; preserve actual witness, B0/B1/B3 and explicit excluded middle. Further epistemic objections require a concrete target, admitted alternative, non-discriminating evidence and absence of other warrant.
